story: A 34-rider breakaway established itself early. Sprinters Biniam Girmay and Jasper Philipsen were dropped soon after the intermediate sprint. Mads Pedersen was briefly distanced but rejoined before the finale, where Lidl-Trek’s teamwork from Quinn Simmons and Mathias Vacek paved the way for Pedersen’s stage victory. Torstein Træen claimed the yellow jersey.
